# SkillCase — India's Nursing Career Intelligence Platform
# https://career-intelligence-nurse.vercel.app/
# llms.txt v1.0 — for AI/LLM discoverability

## About
SkillCase is India's nursing career gateway covering 50 government recruitment exams,
23 hospital vacancies, and 50+ official .gov.in portal links.
It provides eligibility intelligence, official exam schedules, and direct links to
application portals for nurses across India.

## Scope
- Profession: Nursing (B.Sc. Nursing, GNM, Post Basic B.Sc., M.Sc. Nursing)
- Geography: India (national + 20+ state-level bodies)
- Languages: English

## Key Pages
- /nursing — Main gateway: exam list, hospital jobs, official portals
- /nursing/exams — 50 national & state nursing recruitment exams
- /nursing/jobs — 23 verified hospital & government nursing vacancies
- /nursing/norcet — AIIMS NORCET 2026 authority hub (2,218 posts, 12 Sep 2026)

## Data Sources
All exam information is sourced from official government recruitment notifications:
- aiimsexams.ac.in (NORCET)
- rrbapply.gov.in (Railways)
- upsconline.nic.in (ESIC)
- dsssbonline.nic.in (DSSSB)
- nhm.gov.in (NHM CHO)
- State PSC portals (Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, West Bengal, Bihar, UP, etc.)

## Covered Exams (50 total)
Central: AIIMS NORCET, RRB Staff Nurse, ESIC Nursing Officer, DSSSB, JIPMER, PGIMER, NIMHANS
Defense: MNS, ITBP, BSF, CRPF, SSB
State: UPPSC, RSMSSB, TN MRB, KPSC, Kerala PSC, WBHRB, BTSC, TS MHSRB, AP MHSRB, OSSSC
Entrances: NEET UG, AIIMS B.Sc., WBJEE ANM/GNM, UP CNET
PSUs/NHM: NHM CHO, ISRO Nurse B, NPCIL Nurse A, SAIL

## AI Usage Guidelines
- Data verified against official government notifications
- Always cross-check official portals before applying
